signals.text:
This is not not like my other Vera Bradley purses!

I ordered the Ivy Green. It’s looks like a dark olive green to me, and
The color is ok. I like it, it’s non-described, blends with most anything I would wear.
The lining is white with dark green and grayish flowers, nothing special.

There is one zipper compartment on the outside front, I personally
Would rather have it on the inside, where the few things in there
Would not look bulky in the front.
<

I wore these to work. They were comfortable and have large front pockets. They also resist wrinkles which is very nice. I washed them and dried them on permanent press (although label says low). I removed them from the dryer immediately and they came out looking new without any wrinkles.
